visuals.heading: What Most Freelancers Really Earn

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: There is no official average income for freelancers in India. Press reports of the Economic Survey 2025-26 count about 1.2 crore gig and platform workers and say around 40% earn below Rs 15,000 a month, a figure we could not check in the survey itself. Press coverage puts the biggest concentration of that work in e-commerce and logistics, so it is a weak guide to skilled freelancing.
figures.text: There is no official average income for freelancers in India. Press reports of the Economic Survey 2025-26 count about 1.2 crore gig and platform workers and say around 40% earn below Rs 15,000 a month, a figure we could not check in the survey itself. Press coverage puts the biggest concentration of that work in e-commerce and logistics, so it is a weak guide to skilled freelancing.

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: For skilled freelancing the signals are small. AmbitionBox shows an average starting pay of about Rs 10,000 a month (page updated 28 December 2024), and Upwork says beginners typically charge about $10 to $25 an hour. Lakhs a month is a real outcome for some people, but it is the strong end of the range, not the middle.
